parameters.name: AclName
parameters.description: The name of the ACL. The name must be 1 to 80 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), and underscores (\_). The name of the ACL that you create must be unique within each region.

parameters.name: AddressIPVersion
parameters.description: The IP version. Valid values: **ipv4** and **ipv6**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the ACL.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of tag N. Valid values of N: **1** to **20**. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. It cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of tag N. Valid values of N: **1** to **20**. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value must be 0 to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
